data.desc: monday.com is the AI workspace where people and agents drive business results together. Around 250,000 customers worldwide use monday.com to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together in one flexible workspace, where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. From work management and CRM to service and dev, every monday.com product runs on the same AI layer, automating tasks, running workflows, and helping teams deliver exponentially more with less effort.
